enforced_by: the video teardown's doctrine read (the emotional map); recorded as unknown, never refused
note: The emotional map's feelings (the owner, 2026-10-13) — the only words a beat's feeling is spelled in.

rows.name: Curiosity
rows.what: An open question the viewer wants closed — 'wait, what is that?'

extra.on_screen: Something unexplained or out of place, an action cut before it finishes, a claim with the reason held back.

rows.name: Surprise
rows.what: A jolt — the expected thing does not happen.

extra.on_screen: A pattern set up and broken, an unexpected person or place, a sudden cut, sound or reveal.

rows.name: Recognition
rows.what: 'That's me' — the viewer sees their own life, habit or moment on screen.

extra.on_screen: A specific, true-to-life detail of the avatar's day, said or done the way they do it.

rows.name: Frustration
rows.what: The itch of the problem — annoyance at something that keeps not working.

extra.on_screen: The failed attempt shown, the sigh, the thing thrown down, the same struggle repeated.

rows.name: Unease
rows.what: Tension — a quiet worry that something is wrong or about to go wrong.

extra.on_screen: A held close-up, a pause before an answer, a detail noticed that should not be there, sound dropping out.

rows.name: Empathy
rows.what: Feeling for the person on screen — 'oh, I know how that feels.'

extra.on_screen: A real, unperformed moment of the person struggling or exposed, held long enough to land.
Whatever the humor dial and the room's own references allow — never over a claim.

rows.name: Relief
rows.what: The exhale — the problem finally lets go.

extra.on_screen: The struggle stops, the shoulders drop, the easy version of the moment that was hard a beat ago.
Someone like the viewer trying it, a first small change, the mechanism making sense.

rows.name: Desire
rows.what: 'I want that' — wanting the life, the look or the result on screen.

extra.on_screen: The after shown at its best: the person at ease, the result in use, the product handled with care.

rows.name: Trust
rows.what: Belief — 'this is real, these people are straight with me.'

extra.on_screen: Proof shown plainly: a real result, a real person, a demonstration with nothing hidden, a calm unhurried read.

rows.name: Belonging
rows.what: Pride of membership — 'people like me do this.'

extra.on_screen: The avatar's own people, references and world; the product as part of who they already are.

rows.name: Satisfaction
rows.what: The click of something working exactly right.

extra.on_screen: A clean demonstration, a perfect fit, a before-and-after that resolves, a sound that lands.
A real deadline or scarcity from the offer file, the cost of waiting shown, the pace picking up into the close.
Slow, steady shots, soft light, room tone, an unhurried voice.
